description: This file defines a data access object (DAO) class 'ChartDao' within the OrangeHRM system, responsible for retrieving employee distribution data by subunit and location, as well as employee counts, from the database.

classes.name: ChartDao
classes.description: A data access object responsible for fetching employee distribution data and counts for dashboard visualizations.

methods.name: getEmployeeDistributionBySubunit
methods.description: Retrieves a list of SubunitCountPair objects representing employee counts for each subunit at level 1.

methods.name: getUnassignedEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees not assigned to any subunit.

methods.name: getEmployeeCount
methods.description: Private helper method that executes a query to count employees based on search filters.

methods.name: getEmployeeDistributionQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Constructs a query builder wrapper to fetch employees based on subunit filters.

methods.name: getTotalActiveEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of active (non-terminated, non-purged) employees.

methods.name: getEmployeeDistributionByLocation
methods.description: Retrieves distribution of employees across locations, returning LocationEmployeeCount objects grouped by location.
